## Objective
- Build a complete, playable browser-based 3D hair-styling and cutting simulation.

## Requirements
- Include a detailed 3D head, dynamic layered hair with movement and strand collisions, interactive scissors, thinning shears, clippers, and comb.
- Provide visual feedback, textured hair and lighting, sound effects, and responsive controls.

## Decisions
- Implement as a single-page Three.js experience using an import map, custom CSS, and JavaScript.
- Use a soft-bob styling challenge with 480 simulated hair strands.

## Work State
### Completed
- Built the game UI, 3D scene, hair-strand simulation, tools, cutting and comb interactions, breeze toggle, sound, stats, help modal, and reset controls.
- Fixed startup errors and pointer-to-head coordinate mapping; `node --check game.js` passes.
- Limited cutting to one cut per strand per drag stroke, reduced tool radius, and included depth in strand distance checks; a drag test cut `144 / 480` strands and removed `78.6 cm`.
- Verified breeze toggles from both controls, each tool selection updates its detail panel, reset restores stats and turns breeze off, and the 390×844 mobile layout has no horizontal overflow.
- Added an inline SVG favicon in `index.html` to address the observed `/favicon.ico` 404.
